Class LobbyEventHandler

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.server.controller.events.EventQueueHandler<LobbyEvent>
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.server.controller.events.LobbyEventHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
EventHandler<LobbyEvent>
public class LobbyEventHandler extends EventQueueHandler<LobbyEvent>
Event handler for lobby-related events in the Galaxy Truckers game. Manages distribution of events to players within a specific lobby and executes lobby actions associated with events. Extends the EventQueueHandler to process events of type LobbyEvent.

  • Method Details

    • handleEvent

      public void handleEvent(LobbyEvent event)
      Handles lobby events by sending them to the appropriate players and executing any associated lobby actions. If the event has a specific receiver, it's sent only to that player; otherwise, it's broadcast to all players in the lobby.
      Parameters:
      event - the lobby event to be handled
